messages.content: Do I need to pack the stuff in a box for Swift Returns? I don't have the original packaging anymore

Nope, no box needed! With Swift Returns drop-off, just start the return in the Fernway app under Orders > Return an item, choose drop-off, and show the QR code at any Swift Returns drop point. They'll scan it and take the item as-is, and it's always free. Your refund starts within 24 hours of the drop-off scan.
Why did I only get $83 back on my return? the item was $89. Nobody told me there was a fee

Hi, great question, and sorry that wasn't clearer up front! The $5.95 difference is the mail-in return label fee, which applies to Sprout members when a printable return label is used. Return labels are free for Grove and Canopy members, and Swift Returns drop-off is always free for everyone. Next time, just pick drop-off in the app and show the QR code at a drop point, no box or label needed.
I have 3,000 FernPoints. Can I use all of them on a $100 order?

Wow, nice stash! Points redeem in 100-point steps (100 points = $5) and can cover up to 50% of the order subtotal. On a $100 order, that means up to 1,000 points for $50 off, and the remaining 2,000 points stay in your account for next time. Happy shopping!
Tracking says my package was delivered yesterday but it is NOT here. Checked with neighbors and the front office. FW-29384710

I'm so sorry, that's really frustrating, and thank you for already checking with your neighbors and the front office! I've filed a missing-package report for FW-29384710 and set up a free replacement that ships today from Cedar Hollow FC. If you'd rather have a refund instead, just reply and I'll switch it over. I've also added 500 FernPoints ($25) to your account for the trouble.
Are you guys open on Christmas? I might need help with a gift order

Hi! Customer Care is closed on December 25 and Thanksgiving Day, but we're open every other day from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET by chat in the Fernway app or by phone at 555-0163. You can also email fernway.care@example.com anytime, and we'll reply within 12 hours. Happy holidays!
